paragraphs: Think of the Dashboard as your daily control center. When you first log in, you will instantly see exactly how many people are working, who is absent, and if there are any urgent issues that need your attention.
The 'Employees' page is your company directory. This is where you can invite new people to join the software, update their roles, and manage their personal details.
Think of the Dashboard as your daily control center for your team. When you log in, you will instantly see exactly who on your team is online, who is on leave, and if anyone is running late.
It's designed to give you a complete picture of your team's availability in just a few seconds, so you know exactly what resources you have for the day.
Welcome to your HR Portal! The Dashboard is the very first screen you see. This is where you start and end your workday.
You will use the big Clock-In and Clock-Out buttons here to log your daily working hours. You can also quickly see how many leaves you have left and if you have any pending requests.

hr.intro: The Attendance module is where you set the global rules for how time is tracked across the company.
duties: Policies: This is where you define how late someone can be before they get a 'late mark', or when they are automatically marked as 'half-day'.
Shifts: Here you create the actual working hours (like 9 AM to 5 PM) and assign them to employees.

Locations (Geofencing): You can draw circles on a map around your offices or job sites. Employees will only be allowed to click 'Clock In' if their phone's GPS proves they are physically inside that circle!

manager.intro: The Attendance module is where you monitor if your team is following the company's time-tracking rules.
duties: Team Tracking: You can see detailed, day-by-day logs of exactly what time each person on your team clocked in and out.
Compliance: You can easily spot if someone is consistently arriving late or leaving early, helping you manage your team's performance.

employee.intro: The Attendance module tracks your daily working hours. It is important to follow these rules to ensure you are paid correctly.
duties: Geofencing: Your company might require you to be physically at the office to clock in. If so, make sure you are inside the office building before clicking 'Clock In' on your phone.
Shifts: Try your best to adhere to your assigned shift timings (like 9 AM to 5 PM). If you arrive too late, the system might automatically give you a 'late mark' or deduct a half-day!

paragraphs: Holidays & Weekends: This is where you configure the company's official public holidays and default weekends.

Comp Offs: Sometimes employees have to work on a weekend or a holiday. When they do, they can request a 'Compensatory Off' (Comp Off). Once you approve it, the system gives them a free leave balance that they can use to take a paid day off in the future!
Comp Off Requests: If someone on your team works on a weekend or a holiday, they might request a 'Comp Off' (Compensatory Off).
It is your job to review these requests. If they genuinely worked that day, you should approve it. This grants them a free leave balance to take a paid day off later as a reward for their extra work.
Comp Offs: Have you ever been asked to work on a Saturday or a public holiday? The system tracks that extra effort!
If you work on a non-working day, you can request a 'Comp Off'. Once your manager approves it, you earn a free leave balance that you can use to take a paid day off later.
Anomalies happen when something goes wrong with time tracking—like an employee forgetting to clock out, or their internet disconnecting.

Normally, Managers are the ones who fix these issues for their teams. However, as HR, you have the ultimate 'override' power. If a manager is on leave, you can step in and forcefully fix any employee's attendance record here.
Mistakes happen. Your team members might forget to clock out, or their internet might drop. When this happens, the system flags their record as an 'Anomaly'.

To fix it, the employee will submit a 'Regularization' request to you, explaining what happened (e.g., 'I forgot to clock out, I left at 6 PM'). You can review their explanation and click Approve to fix their attendance log.
Mistakes happen! Did you forget to click 'Clock Out' yesterday? Did your internet die right when you were trying to clock in?

When this happens, the system flags your day with an error. Don't panic! Simply go to the 'Regularizations' tab and submit a request to your manager explaining what happened. Once they approve it, your record will be perfectly fixed.
Lock Periods are the most critical step before running Payroll. A Lock Period completely freezes historical data.

For example, if you are running payroll for July, you will 'Lock' the month of July. Once locked, absolutely no one (not even managers) can approve late requests or change attendance records for July. This guarantees that the data you use to pay people will never unexpectedly change.
At the end of every month, HR will 'Lock' the attendance data so they can process salaries.

Once a period is locked, the data is frozen forever. This means you will no longer be able to approve any pending regularization requests from your team for those past dates. Make sure you clear your pending requests before HR locks the month!
At the end of every month, HR freezes all attendance data so they can calculate salaries. This is called a 'Lock Period'.
Once a month is locked, you cannot submit any requests to fix missed punches for those past dates. Always ensure you fix your attendance errors quickly before the month ends!

This is where you extract data to run payroll. You can generate a 'Monthly Report' that gives you a clean spreadsheet showing exactly how many days each person was present, how many days they were absent, and how many overtime hours they worked.
You can also generate 'Detailed Employee Reports' if you need to investigate a specific person's day-by-day punch history.
While HR handles the actual payroll, you can use the Reports module to track your team's long-term performance.
You can generate reports to see who is consistently putting in extra hours, or who is frequently arriving late, helping you manage your team better.
We believe in complete transparency. You can use the Reports module to view your own historical attendance logs at any time.
If you ever want to verify that your paycheck matches the hours you actually worked, you can generate a report here to see your exact records.
